description: Create a focused RFI that helps you qualify suppliers before starting an RFP.

consentExternalProcessing.description: Explicit authorization to send these sources and prior-agent context to the selected inference provider.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable caller key for exactly one logical service request.

inputs.description: Original buyer inputs. Service-specific CSV/date/rubric validation and a combined 75,000-character limit also apply.

context.description: Buyer context — Industry, geography, demand, decision owner and outcome needed.

decisionCriteria.description: What must the RFI establish? — Capacity, references, integrations, geographic coverage and certification questions.

maxChargeUsd.description: Required only for enabled native marketplace token billing: authorize this maximum USD charge with at most six decimal places. Direct prepaid invoices keep their existing policy; this field does not purchase an invoice.

paymentInvoiceId.description: A separate confirmed service invoice when payment is required.
